idea:
A landing page for my startup: 

Mechanistic models whose every number says where it came from.
Describe a mechanism in plain words; Caterva-Sim builds the model, fills its constants from the literature with the reference each came from, and says plainly which numbers nobody has measured.

content.title: Caterva‑Sim
content.intro: We turn plain‑language mechanisms into full mathematical models, automatically pulling constants from the literature and showing each source.

sections.title: Automatic model building
sections.body: Describe a process in words and our engine creates the corresponding equations instantly.

sections.title: Literature‑backed constants
sections.body: Every parameter is sourced from published data, with full citations attached.

sections.title: Transparent gaps
sections.body: Numbers that lack measurement are flagged, with clear notes on their inferred status.

cta.label: Contact us
cta.note: Request a demo or discuss a custom model

closing.headline: Turn ideas into reproducible models
closing.body: With Caterva‑Sim you always know where each number came from.
